Editorial Policy

Grind To Green publishes practical financial education for people building stronger money habits. Our goal is clarity not hype, guarantees, or shortcuts.

How we create content

Articles are written and edited by Mubarak. We use publicly available primary sources, official documentation, reputable educational resources, and practical examples where appropriate. We aim to explain complex topics in plain language and identify assumptions, risks, and limitations.

Accuracy and updates

Markets, regulations, taxes, product features, and interest rates can change. We review and update content when material information changes. Publication and update dates appear on individual articles where available. If you spot an error, email contact@grindtogreen.com with the page URL and supporting information.

Financial-content disclaimer

Our content is for general educational purposes only. It is not individualized financial, investment, legal, or tax advice, and it does not create an adviser-client relationship. Investing, trading, and crypto assets involve risk, including the possible loss of principal. Consider your circumstances and consult a qualified professional before acting on a financial decision.

Independence, advertising, and affiliates

Advertising may help support Grind To Green. When advertising, sponsorships, or affiliate relationships are used, we will disclose them clearly. Compensation does not determine our opinions, coverage, or recommendations. We do not publish paid content that promises returns or hides material conflicts of interest.

Use of AI and editorial review

Tools may assist with research, drafting, or editing, but published content is reviewed for clarity, relevance, and accuracy. We do not rely on automated tools as a substitute for editorial judgment, source checking, or risk disclosures.

Contact

Questions about this policy or a specific article can be sent to contact@grindtogreen.com.
